name: bishop
description: Bishop runs your job search and preps you for the interviews it lands. A setup interview writes your profile and scoring rubric; a scheduled task then sources, verifies, scores, and ranks roles into a digest. Humblebrag, its interview prep, builds study decks you drill out loud: a master deck of the questions every interview asks, answered once in your own words, and a tailored deck for each interview. Includes an optional private web dashboard. You name your own copy during setup.
